select t2.id, t1.plan_no, t1.batch_no, t1.product_date, t1.type, t1.product_name, t1.product_merge_code, t1.product_specification, t1.process_name, t1.process_version, t2.procedure_model_name, t1.id as productPlanId from bm_product_plan t1 inner join bm_product_instruction t2 on t1.id = t2.product_plan_id where t1.instruct_status = 'WAIT_CONFIRM' and t2.status = 'RESOLVE' and t1.status = 'CONFIRM'
and t1.plan_no like concat('%',#{planNo},'%')
and t1.batch_no like concat('%',#{batchNo},'%')
and t1.product_name like concat('%',#{productName},'%')
and t1.process_name like concat('%',#{processName},'%')
and t1.type = #{type}
and t2.principal in
#{roleId}
and t1.process_id in
#{processId}
order by t2.create_time desc
